description: This file contains test functions for validating Kubernetes policy API structures, including PodDisruptionBudgetSpec and PodDisruptionBudgetStatus, as well as sysctl pattern validation.

methods.name: TestValidatePodDisruptionBudgetSpec
methods.description: Tests validation of PodDisruptionBudgetSpec with various minAvailable and maxUnavailable values.

methods.name: TestValidateMinAvailablePodDisruptionBudgetSpec
methods.description: Tests validation of MinAvailable field with valid and invalid percentage and integer values.

methods.name: TestValidateMinAvailablePodAndMaxUnavailableDisruptionBudgetSpec
methods.description: Tests validation when both MinAvailable and MaxUnavailable are set.

methods.name: TestValidateUnhealthyPodEvictionPolicyDisruptionBudgetSpec
methods.description: Tests validation of UnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy field with valid, empty, and invalid policies.

methods.name: TestValidatePodDisruptionBudgetStatus
methods.description: Tests validation of PodDisruptionBudgetStatus fields and conditions for different error scenarios.

methods.name: TestIsValidSysctlPattern
methods.description: Validates various sysctl pattern strings for correctness.
